captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classic flat pocket comb with custom engraved text. It features a solid, flat rectangular spine with rounded semicircular ends, transitioning into a row of evenly spaced, thin teeth. The entire comb is thin and flat, with a small name engraved on the central handle portion of the spine.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable pocket comb using OpenSCAD. The comb should feature a rounded rectangular spine (or 'langloch' shape), a customizable array of teeth, and an optional engraved text area on the spine. Provide parameters for overall length, spine width, thickness, and the custom text string.
captions.factory: The code defines a custom helper module 'langloch' which constructs a rounded rectangle using a central 'cube' and two 'cylinder' primitives at the ends. The main 'kamm' module uses 'difference' to cut teeth out of this base shape using a 'for' loop that translates and subtracts thin rectangular 'cube' volumes. Custom text is then rendered onto the spine using the external 'write' library, and the entire assembly is rotated for printing orientation.
